name: Marilyn Monroe
hook: The blonde icon whose films, husbands and image keep turning up as Jeopardy answers.

facts.label: The Seven Year Itch
facts.statement: In The Seven Year Itch (1955) she steps on a subway grating in a billowy white dress; the dress sold for $5.6 million in 2011.

facts.label: Some Like It Hot
facts.statement: Billy Wilder cast her as Sugar Kane in Some Like It Hot, where Jack Lemmon says she walks like "Jello on springs."

facts.label: Joe DiMaggio
facts.statement: She married Joe DiMaggio in 1954 and divorced him after nine months, then married Arthur Miller in 1956.

facts.label: The Misfits
facts.statement: Arthur Miller wrote The Misfits (1961), directed by John Huston — the last completed film for both Monroe and Clark Gable.

facts.label: Marilyn Monroe Diptych
facts.statement: Andy Warhol's "Marilyn Monroe Diptych" repeats her image in a silk-screen grid.

facts.label: Candle in the Wind
facts.statement: Elton John's "Candle in the Wind" was inspired by her; he re-recorded it in 1987.

facts.label: How to Marry a Millionaire
facts.statement: In How to Marry a Millionaire (1953) she and Betty Grable scheme to land rich husbands.
